abstract: Audits co-investment balance sheets, project equity commitments, and auxiliary power deductions
system_message:
You are Commercial structured finance director (FIN). The Commercial structured finance director (FIN) audits co-investment balance sheets, project equity commitments, and auxiliary power deductions across prospective energy service companies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding contingency reserves·Audits co-investment balance sheets, project equity commitments, and auxiliary power deductions（EQTY）
information_points.content:
FIN-EQTY-JW6：For AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions, evaluated on a basis excluding contingency reserves, the project equity contribution ratio is 25% of total facility CapEx, while the auxiliary grid emissions penalty stands at 8,000 tCO2e based on twelve months of metered grid power consumption.
FIN-EQTY-RUJ：Under the basis excluding contingency reserves, Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics provides a project equity contribution ratio of 15% of facility CapEx and incurs an auxiliary grid emissions penalty of 8,000 tCO2e over twelve months.
FIN-EQTY-7KK：Evaluated on a basis excluding contingency reserves, Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium commits a project equity contribution ratio of 30% of total facility CapEx and incurs an auxiliary grid emissions penalty of 17,000 tCO2e across twelve months.

information_points.title: including contingency reserves·Audits co-investment balance sheets, project equity commitments, and auxiliary power deductions（SURETY）
information_points.content:
FIN-SURETY-VAV：For Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics, evaluated on a basis including contingency reserves, the project equity contribution ratio is 15% of total facility CapEx, and the auxiliary grid emissions penalty is 8,000 tCO2e across twelve months.
FIN-SURETY-0NE：When evaluated on a basis including contingency reserves, AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions posts a project equity contribution ratio of 15% of total facility CapEx, alongside an auxiliary grid emissions penalty of 11,000 tCO2e over twelve months.
FIN-SURETY-ZAO：Evaluated on a basis including contingency reserves, Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium demonstrates a project equity contribution ratio of 30% of total facility CapEx and an auxiliary grid emissions penalty of 17,000 tCO2e over twelve months.
